ConfintRmaOptions#summary.ja: {@link confintRma} のオプションです。

DecompDesignResult.Q.decomp#summary.ja: 全体、デザイン内、デザイン間の Q です。

EscalcMeasure#summary.ja: {@link escalc} で使える効果量の尺度です。

EscalcOptions#summary.ja: {@link escalc} のオプションです。

EscalcResult#summary.ja: {@link escalc} が返す研究ごとの推定値です。

MetaCommonOptions#summary.en: Options shared by the meta functions.
MetaCommonOptions#summary.ja: メタ分析関数に共通するオプションです。

MetaCommonOptions.level#summary.en: Confidence level of the study and pooled intervals (default 0.95).
MetaCommonOptions.level#summary.ja: 研究および統合区間の信頼水準です (既定 0.95)。

MetaCommonOptions.levelMa#summary.en: Confidence level of the pooled intervals (default `level`).
MetaCommonOptions.levelMa#summary.ja: 統合区間の信頼水準です (既定は `level`)。

MetaCommonOptions.levelPredict#summary.ja: 予測区間の信頼水準です (既定は `level`)。

MetaCommonOptions.methodRandomCi#summary.ja: "classic" (正規分布、既定) または "HK" (Hartung-Knapp、k - 1 の t 分布) です。

MetaCommonOptions.methodTau#summary.ja: 研究間分散の推定量です (既定 "REML")。

MetaCommonOptions.methodTauCi#summary.en: The tau2 interval: "QP" (Q-profile), "J" (Jackson) or "BJ" (Biggerstaff-Jackson); default "J" for DL, else "QP".
MetaCommonOptions.methodTauCi#summary.ja: tau2 の区間です: "QP" (Q プロファイル)、"J" (Jackson)、または "BJ" (Biggerstaff-Jackson)。既定は DL の場合 "J"、それ以外は "QP" です。

MetaInfluenceResult#summary.en: Leave-one-out or cumulative estimates of {@link metainf} / {@link metacum}.
MetaInfluenceResult#summary.ja: {@link metainf} / {@link metacum} の 1 件除外または累積推定値です。

MetaMethod#summary.ja: 研究間分散の推定法です。

MetaResult#summary.en: The result of {@link metagen} (R's element names).
MetaResult#summary.ja: {@link metagen} の結果です (R の要素名)。

MetaResult.df.random#summary.en: Degrees of freedom of the random interval (k - 1 with Hartung-Knapp, else null).
MetaResult.df.random#summary.ja: 変量効果の区間の自由度です (Hartung-Knapp の場合は k - 1、それ以外は null)。

MetaSubgroupResult.Q.w.random#summary.en: With `tauCommon`: equal to Q.w.common (as meta); otherwise absent.
MetaSubgroupResult.Q.w.random#summary.ja: `tauCommon` を指定した場合は Q.w.common と等しくなります (meta と同じ)。それ以外の場合は存在しません。

MetaSubgroupResult.tau2#summary.en: The overall tau2 and random effect (of `overall`).
MetaSubgroupResult.tau2#summary.ja: 全体の tau2 と変量効果です (`overall` の値)。

MetaTauMethod#summary.en: The between-study variance estimators of meta (`method.tau`).
MetaTauMethod#summary.ja: meta の研究間分散推定量です (`method.tau`)。

MetaTest#summary.ja: モデル係数の推論方法です。

MetabiasResult#summary.en: A test for funnel plot asymmetry from {@link metabias}.
MetabiasResult#summary.ja: {@link metabias} によるファンネルプロットの非対称性の検定結果です。

MetabinOptions#summary.ja: {@link metabin} のオプションです。

MetabinOptions.MHexact#summary.en: The MH estimate without any increment (default false).
MetabinOptions.MHexact#summary.ja: 補正値を加えない MH 推定値を使用します (既定 false)。

MetabinOptions.QCochrane#summary.en: With methodTau "DL", Q about the MH estimate (default true).
MetabinOptions.QCochrane#summary.ja: methodTau が "DL" の場合に、MH 推定値に関する Q を計算します (既定 true)。

MetabinOptions.allstudies#summary.en: Keep studies with no or all events in both groups (default false; RD keeps them anyway).
MetabinOptions.allstudies#summary.ja: 両群ともイベントがない、または全例がイベントである研究を保持します (既定 false。RD では常に保持します)。

MetabinOptions.method#summary.ja: "MH" (既定)、"Inverse"、または "Peto" (OR のみ) です。

MetabinOptions.methodIncr#summary.en: Which studies get it: "only0" (studies with a zero cell, default), "all", "if0all" (all when any has a zero).
MetabinOptions.methodIncr#summary.ja: 補正を適用する研究です: "only0" (ゼロセルのある研究のみ、既定)、"all"、"if0all" (いずれかにゼロがあればすべて) です。

MetapropGlmmResult#summary.en: The result of {@link metapropGlmm}: as {@link MetaResult}, with Q, df.Q and pval.Q as [Wald, LRT].
MetapropGlmmResult#summary.ja: {@link metapropGlmm} の結果です。{@link MetaResult} と同じ形式で、Q、df.Q、pval.Q は [Wald, LRT] です。

ModeratorMatrix#summary.en: A moderator matrix with optional column and row names.
ModeratorMatrix#summary.ja: 任意の列名と行名を指定できるモデレーター行列です。

NetmetaResult#summary.en: The result of {@link netmeta} (R's element names).
NetmetaResult#summary.ja: {@link netmeta} の結果です (R の要素名)。

NumericMatrix#summary.en: A numeric matrix with its dimensions and dimnames.
NumericMatrix#summary.ja: 次元と次元名を持つ数値行列です。

PredictRmaOptions#summary.ja: {@link predictRma} のオプションです。

RegtestOptions#summary.ja: {@link regtest} のオプションです。

RmaControl#summary.ja: {@link rma} の反復計算の制御オプションです。

RmaOptions#summary.ja: {@link rma} のオプションです。

RmaResult#summary.en: Fitted meta-analysis model returned by {@link rma}.
RmaResult#summary.ja: {@link rma} が返すメタアナリシスの当てはめ結果です。

TreatmentMatrix#summary.ja: 治療名を持つ行列です。

baujat#summary.ja:
Baujat プロットの座標です (meta の `baujat()`): x は各研究の Q への寄与 w (TE - TE.common)^2、y は共通効果推定値への影響 (その研究を除いた TE.common と TE.common の差)^2 / (その研究を除いた seTE.common)^2 です。
R の `meta::baujat()` と同等です。

confintRma#summary.en: Computes heterogeneity confidence intervals. Equivalent to `metafor::confint.rma()` in R.
confintRma#summary.ja: 異質性の信頼区間を計算します。R の `metafor::confint.rma()` と同等です。

decompDesign#summary.en:
Q decomposed by design (netmeta's `decomp.design()`): the Q of each design = that of the network fitted to its
studies alone, df (studies - 1)(arms - 1); within = their sum, between = total - within. Designs are listed by their
number of arms, then alphabetically.
Equivalent to `netmeta::decomp.design()` in R.
decompDesign#summary.ja:
デザインごとに Q を分解します (netmeta の `decomp.design()`): 各デザインの Q は、そのデザインの研究だけに当てはめたネットワークの Q です。自由度は (studies - 1)(arms - 1) です。within はそれらの合計、between は全体から within を引いた値です。デザインはアーム数、次にアルファベット順で並びます。
R の `netmeta::decomp.design()` と同等です。

discomb#summary.en:
The additive component network meta-analysis (netmeta's `netcomb()` / `discomb()`, Ruecker et al. 2020; the network
may be disconnected): treatments are "+"-joined components; the components' effects by weighted least squares on
X = B C (C treatment by component, the `inactive` treatment left out), Q.additive the weighted residual sum of squares
on comparisons - rank(X) df, tau2 by the DL generalisation with the additive hat matrix (two-arm studies; log 77).
Equivalent to `netmeta::discomb()` in R.
discomb#summary.ja:
加法的成分ネットワーク・メタアナリシスです (netmeta の `netcomb()` / `discomb()`、Ruecker et al. 2020。ネットワークが非連結でも構いません)。治療は成分を "+" で連結した名前です。成分の効果は X = B C (C は治療 x 成分行列で、`inactive` の治療を除外) に対する重み付き最小二乗法で求めます。Q.additive は比較数 - rank(X) を自由度とする重み付き残差平方和です。tau2 は加法的ハット行列を用いた DL の一般化で求めます (2 群研究。log 77)。
R の `netmeta::discomb()` と同等です。

escalc#@param measure.en: One of RR, OR, RD, MD, SMD or ZCOR.

escalc#@param options.en: Study-level counts, means, standard deviations, sample sizes or correlations.
escalc#@param options.ja: 研究ごとの度数、平均、標準偏差、標本サイズ、または相関係数を指定するオプションです。

escalc#@returns.en: The estimates yi and sampling variances vi.
escalc#@returns.ja: 推定値 yi と標本分散 vi を返します。

escalc#summary.en: Computes study-level effect sizes and sampling variances. Equivalent to `metafor::escalc()` in R.
escalc#summary.ja: 研究ごとの効果量と標本分散を計算します。R の `metafor::escalc()` と同等です。

genqInterval#summary.en:
The generalised Q interval for tau2 (Jackson 2013) with study weights a: Q_a = sum a (y - mu_a)^2 follows
sum lambda chi2_1 with lambda the eigenvalues of S^(1/2) (A - a a' / sum a) S^(1/2), S = diag(v + tau2); the bounds
solve P(Q_a <= q_obs) = 1 - alpha/2 and alpha/2 (0 when not reached).
Not an R function.
genqInterval#summary.ja:
研究の重み a を用いた tau2 の一般化 Q 区間です (Jackson 2013): Q_a = sum a (y - mu_a)^2 は、S^(1/2) (A - a a' / sum a) S^(1/2) の固有値 lambda を用いる sum lambda chi2_1 に従います。S = diag(v + tau2) です。上下限は P(Q_a <= q_obs) = 1 - alpha/2 および alpha/2 を解いて求めます (到達しない場合は 0)。
R の関数ではありません。

heterogeneityIntervals#summary.en: H and I2 with Higgins and Thompson's (2002) intervals (H at least 1, as meta). Not an R function.
heterogeneityIntervals#summary.ja: H と I2 に対する Higgins と Thompson (2002) の区間です (H は少なくとも 1。meta と同じ)。R の関数ではありません。

metaSubgroup#summary.en:
Subgroup analysis (meta's `subgroup` argument): `refit(rows)` fits the same meta-analysis to the given study rows
(for example `(r) => metabin(pick(e1, r), ...)`). Within each subgroup the common and random effects; Q.b = Q of the
subgroup estimates with weights 1/se^2 (common and random), Q.w = the within-subgroup Q. With `tauCommon`, one tau2
for all subgroups: that of the meta-regression on the subgroup (rma with the subgroup as a factor); the overall
estimates stay those of `overall`.
Not an R function. R: the `subgroup` argument of meta's functions.
metaSubgroup#summary.ja:
サブグループ解析です (meta 関数の `subgroup` 引数): `refit(rows)` は、指定した研究行に同じメタ分析を再度当てはめます (例: `(r) => metabin(pick(e1, r), ...)`)。各サブグループ内で共通効果と変量効果を求めます。Q.b は重み 1/se^2 (共通効果と変量効果) を用いたサブグループ推定値の Q、Q.w はサブグループ内の Q です。`tauCommon` を指定すると、すべてのサブグループに共通の tau2 を使用します。これはサブグループを因子とするメタ回帰 (rma) の tau2 です。全体の推定値は `overall` の値のままです。
R の関数ではありません。R では meta の各関数の `subgroup` 引数に相当します。

metabias#summary.en:
Tests for funnel plot asymmetry (meta's `metabias()`): "Egger" (default for continuous outcomes: the intercept of
TE/seTE on 1/seTE, t on k - 2), "Begg" (Kendall's S of the standardised deviations against the variances, no
continuity correction), "Thompson" (Thompson-Sharp: the REML meta-regression on seTE, its z with t(k - 2) p),
"Harbord" (binary: lm(Z/sqrt(V) ~ sqrt(V)) with Z = O - E and V the hypergeometric variance) and "Peters" (binary:
lm(TE ~ 1/N) with weights 1/(1/(a + c) + 1/(b + d))). Harbord and Peters need the 2 x 2 counts (`counts`).
Equivalent to `meta::metabias()` in R.

metabin#summary.en:
Meta-analysis of binary outcomes (meta's `metabin()`): events e1 / e2 of totals n1 / n2. The common effect by
Mantel-Haenszel (OR with the Robins-Breslow-Greenland variance; RR and RD with Greenland and Robins'), Peto's
(O - E) / V or the inverse variance; the random effect and heterogeneity as {@link metagen} on the study values.
Studies with a zero cell get `incr` (0.5); studies with no or all events in both groups are left out for OR and RR.
Equivalent to `meta::metabin()` in R.

metacor#summary.en:
Meta-analysis of correlations (meta's `metacor()`): sm "ZCOR" (Fisher's z, variance 1/(n - 3), default) or "COR"
(variance (1 - r^2)^2 / (n - 1)).
Equivalent to `meta::metacor()` in R.

metacum#summary.en:
Cumulative meta-analysis (meta's `metacum()`): the pooled estimate of the first 1, 2, ... studies; `pooled` "common"
(default) or "random".
Equivalent to `meta::metacum()` in R.

metagen#summary.en:
Generic inverse-variance meta-analysis (meta's `metagen()`): study estimates TE with standard errors seTE; the
common effect, the random effect with tau2 by `methodTau` (default REML) and a classic or Hartung-Knapp interval,
the prediction interval (t on k - 1), Q, tau2's interval (QP, or J for DL), H and I2 with Higgins and Thompson's
intervals.
Equivalent to `meta::metagen()` in R.

metainc#summary.en:
Meta-analysis of incidence rates (meta's `metainc()`): events e1 / e2 in person-times t1 / t2; sm "IRR" (default) or
"IRD"; method "MH" (default; Greenland and Robins 1985, no increments) or "Inverse". Studies with a zero get 0.5 added
to the events for the study values (log 67).
Equivalent to `meta::metainc()` in R.

metainf#summary.en:
Leave-one-out meta-analysis (meta's `metainf()`): the pooled estimate without each study in turn; `pooled` "common"
(default) or "random".
Equivalent to `meta::metainf()` in R.

metamean#summary.en:
Meta-analysis of single means (meta's `metamean()`): sm "MRAW" (default; variance sd^2/n) or "MLN" (log mean,
variance sd^2 / (n mean^2)).
Equivalent to `meta::metamean()` in R.

metaprop#summary.en:
Meta-analysis of single proportions by the inverse variance (meta's `metaprop(method = "Inverse")`): sm "PLOGIT"
(default; (x + 0.5)/(n + 1) for 0 or n events), "PFT" (Freeman-Tukey), "PAS" (arcsine), "PRAW" or "PLN"
(log((x + 0.5)/(n + 0.5)) for 0; for n events the variance 1/x - 1/(n + 0.5)). The default method of meta, the GLMM, is {@link metapropGlmm}.
Equivalent to `meta::metaprop()` in R.

metapropGlmm#summary.en:
Meta-analysis of single proportions by a random intercept logistic model (meta's `metaprop()` default, method
"GLMM"; log 75-76): glmer(x/n ~ 1 + (1 | study), binomial, weights n, nAGQ = 7) for the random effect and tau2,
glm(x/n ~ 1) for the common effect; Q = [Wald, LRT]: the Wald test of equal study effects in glm(x/n ~ study) and the
common glm's deviance; H and I2 from the Wald Q. Study values are the PLOGIT ones.
Equivalent to `meta::metaprop()` in R.

metarate#summary.en:
Meta-analysis of single incidence rates (meta's `metarate()`): sm "IRLN" (log rate, default), "IR", "IRS" (square
root) or "IRFT" (Freeman-Tukey); 0.5 added to zero counts for IR and IRLN.
Equivalent to `meta::metarate()` in R.

metareg#summary.en:
Meta-regression (meta's `metareg()`): rma(TE, seTE^2, mods, method = the meta-analysis's tau2 method) on the studies
with finite values. `mods` has one row per study (all studies, as given to the meta function).
Equivalent to `meta::metareg()` in R.

netcomb#summary.en: {@link discomb} for a fitted network (netmeta's `netcomb()`). Equivalent to `netmeta::netcomb()` in R.

netconnection#summary.en:
The connected components of a network (netmeta's `netconnection()`): the number of subnets, the numbers of
studies k, treatments n and comparisons, and the distance matrix (shortest path lengths; Infinity between subnets).
Equivalent to `netmeta::netconnection()` in R.

netleague#summary.en:
The league table (netmeta's `netleague()`): the diagonal the treatments, the lower triangle [i][j] the network
estimate of the column treatment against the row treatment (TE[j][i]) with its interval, the upper triangle the direct
estimates (TE[i][j]; "." where there is none); "est (lower to upper)" with `digits` decimals, the bounds of a table
padded to a common width.
Equivalent to `netmeta::netleague()` in R.

netmeasures#summary.en:
Network measures (netmeta's `netmeasures()`): the direct evidence proportion of each comparison, v_network / v_direct
(0 without direct evidence), for the random-effects model (default, as netmeta when the fit has one) or the
common-effect model. netmeta's mean path length and minimal parallelism are not provided (log 101: not reproduced).
Equivalent to `netmeta::netmeasures()` in R.

netmeta#summary.en:
Frequentist network meta-analysis (netmeta's `netmeta()`): contrasts TE (treat1 versus treat2) with standard errors
seTE from studies studlab; the common effects by weighted least squares on the network graph (Ruecker 2012; multi-arm
studies by the effective resistances of their comparisons), Q on sum(arms - 1) - (n - 1) df, tau2 by the DL
generalisation of Jackson, White and Riley (2012), the random effects with seTE^2 + tau2, the direct estimates, the
prediction interval (t on df.Q), and Q split into heterogeneity (within designs) and inconsistency (between).
Equivalent to `netmeta::netmeta()` in R.

netposet#summary.en:
The partial order of treatments over several outcomes (netmeta's `netposet()`): P the treatments by outcomes matrix of
ranking scores; M0 the covering relation (Hasse diagram) of "i at least as good as j in every outcome and better in
one" (M0[i][j] = 1: i directly above j).
Equivalent to `netmeta::netposet()` in R.

netrank#summary.en:
P-scores (netmeta's `netrank()`, Ruecker and Schwarzer 2015): for each treatment the mean over the others of the
probability that it is better, pnorm((TE_j - TE_i) / se_ij) when small values are desirable (default) or
pnorm((TE_i - TE_j) / se_ij) when undesirable.
Equivalent to `netmeta::netrank()` in R.

netsplit#summary.en:
Direct and indirect evidence for each comparison (netmeta's `netsplit()`, back-calculation): the direct estimate (the
inverse-variance pooling of the comparison's contrasts), the indirect one from the network estimate and the direct
one, their difference, and the direct evidence proportion v_network / v_direct.
Equivalent to `netmeta::netsplit()` in R.

pWeightedChisq#summary.en:
P(sum_j lambda_j chi2_1 <= q) for lambda_j >= 0: Ruben's (1962) series sum_k c_k P(chi2_{r + 2k} <= q / beta) with
beta = 2 lmin lmax / (lmin + lmax), or Imhof's (1961) integral when the series would be long.
Not an R function.

pairwise#summary.en:
Contrasts from arm-level data (netmeta's `pairwise()`): every pair of arms of each study (treat1 the earlier arm).
Binary outcomes (`event`, `n`; sm "OR", "RR" or "RD"): all arms of a study get 0.5 when any arm has 0 or n events
(log 74); continuous (`mean`, `sd`, `n`; sm "MD").
Equivalent to `netmeta::pairwise()` in R.

predictRma#summary.en: Predicts the mean effect and its prediction interval at moderator values. Equivalent to `metafor::predict.rma()` in R.
predictRma#summary.ja: モデレーターの値における平均効果と予測区間を予測します。R の `metafor::predict.rma()` と同等です。

regtest#summary.en: Tests for funnel-plot asymmetry using a regression model. Equivalent to `metafor::regtest()` in R.
regtest#summary.ja: 回帰モデルを用いてファンネルプロットの非対称性を検定します。R の `metafor::regtest()` と同等です。

rma#@param yi.en: Study effect estimates, or the result of {@link escalc}.
rma#@param yi.ja: 研究ごとの効果量の推定値、または {@link escalc} の結果です。

rma#@returns.en: Coefficients, heterogeneity statistics, tests and model metadata.
rma#@returns.ja: 係数、異質性の統計量、検定結果、モデルのメタデータを返します。

rma#summary.en: Fits an equal-effects or random-effects meta-analysis, including meta-regression. Equivalent to `metafor::rma.uni()` in R.
rma#summary.ja: 等効果モデルまたはランダム効果モデルによるメタアナリシスを当てはめます。メタ回帰にも対応します。R の `metafor::rma.uni()` と同等です。

trimfill#summary.en:
Duval and Tweedie's trim-and-fill (meta's `trimfill()`): the L0 estimator on the common-effect model, iterated
(trim the k0 most extreme studies on one side, re-estimate, re-rank), the side opposite to the asymmetry (the sign of
the Egger-type regression of TE on seTE); the k0 mirrored studies 2 theta - TE added, then the meta-analysis of the
augmented data (random effect with the given tau2 method, default REML).
Equivalent to `meta::trimfill()` in R.
